column3: NKJV has “the kingdom of God” and “all these things,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “His kingdom” and “these things.”
Close to the Greek; “make them recline” is rendered “have them sit down to eat.”
NKJV includes “he would have watched,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “he would not have allowed his house to be broken into.”
NKJV has “to send fire on the earth,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text reads “to cast fire upon the earth.”
NKJV has “how is it you do not discern,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “how do you not know how to discern.”
Close to the Greek; “lepton” is rendered “mite.”
